# rok-ui

> A shadcn/ui-style component system and app framework for GPUI desktop apps, with a React-like
> developer experience: `#[component]` functions, hooks, StyleX-style `styles!`, JSX-like
> `view!` markup, right-to-left layouts, motion, app shells, reactive state, a router, a
> TanStack Query-style data layer and PostgreSQL through rok-db.

This file is a dense digest for coding agents. Read `AGENTS.md` for the task skills, and the
guides in `docs/guide/` for detail. Crates: `rok-ui` (facade, `src/`), `rok-ui-macros`
(`macros/`, proc-macro entry points only), `rok-ui-grammar` (macro parsing and codegen, tested in
`rok-ui-grammar/tests`), `rok-ui-build` (the file-route generator), `rok-ui-cli` (`cargo rok-ui`). MSRV: `rust-version` in `Cargo.toml`. License: MIT.

## Setup

- `use rok_ui::prelude::*;` brings in GPUI's prelude, every enabled component, the theme, the
  hooks, motion, `Sx` and the macros.
- Call `rok_ui::init(cx)` once at startup (installs the theme and keyboard focus tracking) and
  pass `rok_ui::Assets` to `Application::with_assets`.
- Features: `default = ["full"]`; `full` = groups `forms` (which includes `form`), `overlays`,
  `layout`, `data`, `chat`, `shell`, `state`. Opt-in: `router`, `query`, `runtime`, `persist`,
  `devtools`, `form-garde`, `db` (+ `db-chrono`, `db-uuid`, `db-json`, `db-migrate`), fonts (`font-cairo`, `font-inter`,
  `font-noto-sans-arabic`, group `fonts`). Each component is its own kebab-case feature.

- New app: `cargo install rok-ui-cli`, then `cargo rok-ui new my-app --template full`
  (`minimal` | `full` | `db`); `cargo rok-ui add button` copies a component's source into
  `src/components/ui/`; `cargo rok-ui routes` writes a checked-in route tree.

## Components

One file per component in `src/components/<name>.rs`, re-exported from `rok_ui::components`.

- forms: button, calendar, checkbox, combobox, date-picker, field, input (+ Textarea),
  input-group, input-otp, label, radio-group, select, slider, switch, toggle
- overlays: alert-dialog, command, dialog, hover-card, menu, menubar, popover, sheet, toast,
  tooltip
- layout: accordion, aspect-ratio, breadcrumb, button-group, card, carousel, collapsible,
  empty, item, layout-widgets, pagination, resizable, scroll-area, separator, sidebar, tabs
- data: alert, avatar, badge, chart, data-table, keyboard-shortcut, progress, skeleton,
  spinner, table, typography
- chat: attachment, bubble, marker, message, message-scroller, questionnaire
- shell: layout-widgets (Row, Column, Expanded, Stack, GridView, LayoutBuilder, ...),
  navigation (NavigationBar, NavigationRail, NavigationDrawer), scaffold (Scaffold, AppBar,
  AdaptiveScaffold)
- shadcn/ui aliases: context-menu, dropdown-menu (menu), drawer (sheet), kbd
  (keyboard-shortcut), native-select (select), navigation-menu (menubar), textarea (input),
  toggle-group (toggle)

API conventions every component follows:

- `Name::new(required..)`; stateful components take an `id` first. Everything else is a
  `#[must_use]` builder that documents its default: `Button::new("save").label("Save").outline().small()`.
- Controlled by default (`value` + `on_change`, `open` + `on_open_change`); uncontrolled
  variants use `default_value` / `default_open` and keep state by `id`.
- Shared prop names: `checked`, `selected_index`, `open`, `disabled`, `invalid`, `size`,
  `variant`.
- Event handlers are `Fn(&Event, &mut Window, &mut App)` (`EventHandler<E>`).
- Every visual component accepts `.sx(..)` and GPUI's `Styled` methods (`.w_full()`); the
  caller's styles are applied last and win.

## Writing components

```rust
#[component]
pub fn Counter(
    title: SharedString,                         // required prop -> Counter::new(title)
    #[default] step: Option<i32>,                // optional prop -> .step(5)
    #[default(px(32.))] size: Pixels,            // optional with a custom default
    #[prop(optional)] on_change: Option<EventHandler<i32>>,
    #[children] children: Vec<AnyElement>,       // makes it a ParentElement
    #[sx] sx: Sx,                                // caller styles, apply last
    window: &mut Window,
    cx: &mut App,                                // or `cx: &mut Cx` instead of window + cx
) -> impl IntoElement { /* ... */ }
```

- Hooks: `use_state(window, cx, || 0)` -> `State<T>` (`get`, `read`, `set`, `update`);
  `use_keyed_state(key, ..)` inside loops. Rules of hooks apply (unconditional, same order).
- `Cx` (`rok_ui::Cx`): one handle over window and app: `cx.use_state(..)`, `cx.get::<G>()`,
  `cx.refresh()`.
- Long-lived shared state lives in a GPUI `Entity<T>` with `cx.notify()`, or in signals
  (`state` feature).

## Styling

- `styles! { pub CARD = { base: { display: flex, gap: 6, radius: xl, background: card,
  hover: { border_color: ring } }, tone(Tone): { Calm: {..}, Loud: {..} } } }` declares a
  static with one `Sx` per key; `CARD.tone(t)` picks a variant (a missing variant is a compile
  error).
- Apply once per element: `.sx((&CARD.base, cond.then_some(&CARD.extra), &self.sx))` or
  `.sx(sx![CARD.base, cond => CARD.extra])`. A second `.sx(..)` with hover or focus states on
  the same element panics (GPUI allows one of each).
- `style! { width: {px(w)}, background: accent }` for one-off or computed values.
- Values follow Tailwind: lengths are multiples of 4px (`gap: 6` = 24px), `50%`, `full`,
  `auto`, `{expr}`; colors are theme tokens (`primary`, `muted_foreground`, `primary/90`);
  radius `none|sm|md|lg|xl|full`; `text: xs..3xl`; `font: medium|semibold|bold`.
- Unknown properties, tokens and keywords are compile errors (trybuild cases in `tests/ui/`).
- Never hard-code colors: use theme tokens so every preset and mode works.

## Markup

- `children![a, if c { x } else { y }, for i in &items => Item::new(i.id), match s { .. }]`
- `view! { Card(sx = [CARD.base]) { CardTitle("Hi") Button("go", label = "Go").outline() } }`:
  `Name(a, key = v)` is `Name::new(a).key(v)`; lowercase `div`, `img`, `svg` are GPUI
  elements; children support `"text"`, `{expr}`, `if`, `if let`, `match`, `for`.
- `#[key(item.id)] for item in items { .. }` keeps hook state with reordered items
  (`Keyed::new(&key, child)` by hand).
- Strings in markup become `BidiText` automatically (correct RTL shaping on Windows). Strings
  passed to GPUI's `.child(..)` directly need `BidiText::new(..)`.

## Right-to-left

- `display: flex` rows flow in reading direction. Use logical properties for anything that
  mirrors (`padding_start`, `margin_end`, `border_start`, `inset_end`) and physical ones only
  when it must not. `direction: row_ltr` / `flex_ltr()` for charts, codes and numbers.
- Read `is_rtl()` while rendering and capture it; event handlers run outside the `Direction`
  scope.

## Theme

- `cx.theme().colors.*` mirrors shadcn/ui variables in snake_case (`background`,
  `primary_foreground`, `destructive_text`, `border`, `ring`); radius helpers
  `radius_small()..radius_extra_large()`.
- `Theme::toggle_mode(cx)`, `Theme::change_preset(ThemePreset::Neutral, cx)`,
  `Theme::sync_with_system_appearance(window, cx)`, `Theme::from_preset(..)` +
  `Theme::set_global(..)` for custom brands. Presets: `Rok` (default), `Neutral`. Every text
  pair must reach 4.5:1 contrast (enforced by a test).

## Motion

`keyframes!`, `Motion` / `MotionExt` on elements, `use_transition`, `use_presence` for enter and
exit animations, `motion::presets`, `Easing`.

## State (`state` feature)

rok-ui-hooks signals re-exported as `rok_ui::state`: `create_signal`, `create_memo`,
`create_store`, `use_signal(window, cx, ..)` for a component's own signal, `cx.track(..)` /
`use_tracked` to re-render when signals read change.

- `#[derive(Store)] struct Todo { title: String }` generates `TodoStore` with a signal per
  field (`todo.title()`, `set_title`, `update_title`, `get`, `set`).
- `persist::persisted_store(cx, "settings", Settings::default)` saves a store as versioned
  JSON in the config directory (feature `persist`; `PersistOptions` for migrations).
- Devtools (feature `devtools`): add `devtools::Devtools::new()` to the root; Ctrl-Shift-D.
  Shows router history, queries and mutations (`query::mutations(cx)`; name one with
  `MutationOptions::key(query_key![..])`).

## Router (`router` feature)

- Code-based: `Router::new().route("/notes/:id", |route, window, cx| ..).redirect(from, to)
  .not_found(..).guard("/admin", |location, cx| Ok(()) or Err(RouteControl::redirect(path)))
  .guard_async("/account", |location, cx| cx.spawn(async |_| Ok(()))).pending(|_, w, cx| ..)
  .loader("/notes/:id", |route, cx| ..)`.
- Typed: `typed_route! { pub struct NoteRoute = "/notes/:id" { pub id: u64 } }` (checked at
  compile time); `Link::to(&NoteRoute { id })`, `router::navigate_to(&route, cx)`,
  `router::use_params::<NoteRoute>(cx)`, `.route_to(|note: NoteRoute, w, cx| ..)`,
  `.loader_to(|note: &NoteRoute, cx| ..)`, `Link::preload(true)` (hover),
  `Link::preload_visible(true)` (on screen); `router::load_state(cx)`
  and `router::use_pending(cx, delay, min)` (pendingMs / pendingMinMs) for progress bars.
- Search params: `#[derive(Search)] struct S { #[search(default = 1)] page: u32, q: Option<String> }`;
  `router::use_search::<S>(cx)`, `router::update_search::<S>(cx, |s| ..)`, `Link::search(&s)`.
- `router::use_blocker(cx, dirty)` holds navigation; `blocker.proceed(cx)` / `reset(cx)`.
- `router::set_per_window_history(true, cx)` gives each window its own history;
  `router::with_window(handle, || ..)`; `router::persist_location("main", cx)` (with `persist`).
- Scroll restoration: `ScrollArea::restore_scroll(true)`, `Scaffold::restore_scroll(true)`.
- File-based: `rok-ui-build` in build-dependencies, `rok_ui_build::routes("src/routes").generate()`
  in build.rs, `rok_ui::routes!();` in the crate, `routes::tree()` renders. Files: `__root.rs`,
  `__not_found.rs`, `index.rs`, `$id.rs`, `$.rs`, `a.b.rs`, `_pathless.rs`, `(group)/`,
  `-ignored/`, `[escaped].rs`. Each file: `file_route! { params: { id: u64 }, search: S,
  component: Page | layout: Layout, before_load: |loc, cx| .., loader: |route, cx| .. }`; in the
  file, `Route` is its generated type and `params(cx)` / `search(cx)` read it.


## Data (`query` feature)

TanStack Query for GPUI, on the shared tokio runtime (`rok_ui::runtime::{get, spawn,
block_on}`):

- Keys: `query_key!["notes", id]` (hierarchical; invalidation matches by prefix).
- `QueryOptions::new(key, |cx| async move { .. })` with `.stale_time`, `.gc_time`, `.retry`,
  `.enabled`, `.initial_data`, `.placeholder_data`, `.keep_previous_data`,
  `.refetch_interval`, `.refetch_on_window_focus`. Define options in a function and reuse them.
- Read: `query::use_query(cx, options)` -> `.state()` is `QueryState::{Pending, Error,
  Success}`; `use_suspense_query` inside `Suspense`; `ErrorBoundary` catches errors.
- Part of the data: `query::use_query_select(cx, options, |data| derived)`; derived again only
  when the cached data changes, and the cache keeps the full value.
- Cache: `invalidate(cx, &key)`, `fetch_query`, `prefetch_query`, `ensure_query_data`,
  `set_query_data`, `update_query_data`, `cancel_queries`, `reset_queries`.
- Writes: `MutationOptions::new(..).invalidates(key).optimistic(..).on_success(..)` with
  `use_mutation`; `#[procedure(invalidates = [..])]` typed commands with `use_procedure` and
  `.call(cx, input)`; `#[memoize]` shares one future between concurrent callers.
- Background code reads app values through `query::provide(cx, value)` and `TaskCx::get`.

## Forms (`form` feature)

- `#[derive(FormValues)] struct SignUp { email: String, team: Vec<Invite> }` adds
  `SignUp::EMAIL: Field<SignUp, String>`; paths compose: `SignUp::TEAM.at(0).then(Invite::EMAIL)`.
- `FormOptions::new(defaults).field(SignUp::EMAIL, Validators::new().on_change(..).on_blur(..)
  .on_change_async_debounce(d, |v| async ..).listen_to(&SignUp::PASSWORD))
  .validators(FormValidators::new().on_submit(|v| Some(FormError::field(&SignUp::CONFIRM, ".."))))
  .on_submit(|values, cx| Task<Result<(), FormError>>)`.
- Long forms: `FormOptions::scroll_handle(handle)` with `ScrollArea::track_scroll(&handle)`;
  a failed submit scrolls the first invalid bound field into view.
- Drafts (with `persist`): `.persist_draft(PersistOptions::new("sign-up"))` restores and saves
  the values (Serialize + Deserialize); a successful submit or `reset` deletes the draft.
- `let form = form::use_form(cx, opts); let email = form.field(cx, SignUp::EMAIL);`
  `TextField::new(&email, "Email")`, `TextareaField`, `CheckboxField`, `SwitchField`,
  `SelectField::new(&f, "Plan").option("pro", "Pro")`, `RadioGroupField`, `ComboboxField`, `SliderField`,
  `DatePickerField` (`Option<CalendarDate>`), `InputOtpField::new(&f, "Code", 6)`, `BoundInput`,
  `SubmitButton::new(&form, "Save")`, `FormErrors::new(&form)`.
- `form.array_field(cx, SignUp::TEAM)`: `push_value`, `remove_value`, `swap_values`,
  `move_value`, `insert_value`, `replace_value`, `push_handler`, `remove_handler`.
- Errors are kept per `ValidationEvent` (`Mount`, `Change`, `Blur`, `Submit`, `Server`).
  `GardeSchema` (feature `form-garde`) validates with `garde::Validate`.

## Database (`db` feature)

PostgreSQL through rok-db (a type-safe async ORM on sqlx), run on the shared runtime:

- `db::connect(url, cx)` or `db::set_connection(Db, cx)` (build the `Db` with
  `db::runtime().block_on(Db::builder()...connect(&url))` for pool and cache settings).
- `db::db_query(query_key!["users"], |db| async move { User::query().all(&db).await })` ->
  `QueryOptions`; `db::db_mutation(|db, input| async move { .. })` -> `MutationOptions`;
  `db::run(cx, |db| async move { .. })` for one-off work; `db::invalidate("users", cx)`.
- `db::watch_changes::<User>(cx).detach()` invalidates `query_key![User::TABLE]` whenever a row
  changes in the database (any process); needs `User::install_change_notifications(&db)` once.
- Models derive rok-db's `Model`; without a direct rok-db dependency add
  `#[rok(crate = "rok_ui::db::rok_db")]`.
- Futures passed in must be `Send + 'static`: clone the data they need, never capture UI
  handles. Errors arrive as `DbError::{NotConnected, Failed, Cancelled}`.
- Deprecated: `db::use_query` (removed in 0.8); use `query::use_query(cx, db::db_query(..))`.

## Conventions

- Lints: `[workspace.lints]` with clippy pedantic, `missing_docs`, `unsafe_code = "deny"`; CI
  denies warnings. Fix, do not silence (an `#[allow]` needs a comment saying why).
- No `mod.rs`: `foo.rs` next to `foo/`. In a file: struct, inherent impl, trait impls,
  private helpers, `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- Every public item has a doc comment; builders are `#[must_use]` and document their default.
- ASCII only in code and docs (test data and RTL examples excepted).
- Tests check behavior; every component renders in every theme and RTL in
  `tests/components.rs`; macro errors are trybuild cases in `tests/ui/`.
- Conventional Commits with rok-ui scopes; release-plz builds `CHANGELOG.md` from them.

## Docs

- Guides: `docs/guide/{app-shells,state,router,query,forms,database}.md` (also the module
  docs). Every doc example compiles (no `ignore` blocks). Upgrading: `docs/migration/0.6.md`.
- Plan: `enhance.md`; progress: `roadmap.md`; changes: `CHANGELOG.md`.
